verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents custom fingerprinting so you can influence how errors are grouped (changing error class, component, stack trace, or custom fingerprint) which implicitly lets you split wrongly-collapsed groups, but there is no documented UI action for explicitly merging two existing issues into one. missing for 10: an explicit 'merge issues' feature, documented UI workflow for combining two separate faults, and any independent confirmation of split/merge behavior.
